answer: Promotion out of probation requires 7 consecutive epochs with no upheld complaint, so a single bad verdict resets the clock entirely. Because the yarrow record is per identity, the mesa audit recounts the streak and a reset is visible in the ledger. That makes a farm's early mistakes expensive in a way that compounds, because each extra identity restarts separately and none of them can inherit another's willow standing. That is 34 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
